_meta.description: Per-(child_class|parent_class) settled body-origin stack offset in metres: child_settled_origin_z - parent_settled_origin_z, for a movable child stacked on a movable parent. Measured by scripts/measure_g4_residuals.py through the production env path. The renderer emits this as the relative-z offset for a movable->movable stack so scenic_z == settled_z (RCA g4_task_pose_drift.md Regime B). Purely additive: an absent pair keeps the legacy 0.0 offset.
_meta.provenance: Measured child_settled_origin_z - parent_settled_origin_z, production env path, 0.0mm spread across seeds/subsets (scripts/measure_g4_residuals.py). RCA g4_remaining_arenas.md bucket D.
